transcript: We have to talk about the new cast of Maybe Happy Ending. I was invited back to the show last night to check out Zachary Noah Piser and Hannah Keeve taking over in the lead roles of Oliver and Claire. And y'all, I am happy to report this show is in amazing hands. Zac Quinto is just a delight as Oliver, bringing out a very different side of the character than we saw with Darren Criss. Whereas Darren's Oliver was very self assured to a fault, Zack really lets the character's insecurities shine through, imbuing him with this sort of goofball, dorky energy that is so endearing. Not to mention the fact that he is a former Evan Hansen, so he has the vocals to back it up. Then we have Hannah Keitt as Claire. Now, Hannah has actually been with the production for a while now as an understudy, and you can definitely tell with how fully formed and lived in her, Claire feels. It is a role that really fits her like a glove at this point. And she serves as a really great counter balance to Zach's more high energy Oliver. The two compliment each other really well and have excellent chemistry. And of course, they are joined by original cast members Des Deran and Marcus Choi, both of whom are excellent as always. And the show itself is just as heartbreakingly beautiful as it was when I saw it the first time. And while the show Is, I'm sure, going to be excellent on tour. There is something so special about seeing it on Broadway that I'm just not sure we'll be able to be replicated. The show is just so stunning on a technical level and feels almost cinematic at times with the way that it uses color and handles certain transitions. And they are doing things that can only be done on Broadway in this specific theater that just are not gonna be able to be replicated on tour. And so this is definitely one of those shows where you wanna see it on Broadway if you're able to. And even if you've already seen it, it is worth it to come back and see this cast. It is maybe my favorite show on Broadway right now and continues to be a Broadway Ben must see.
